plan.title: perf(check,release): one suite at Step 5, real 20-min suite-gate hang (supervisor), full-mode pin — lane fixed host-side (stale CI cache)

narratives.Overview: One suite at release pipeline Step 5, a 20-minute cached-path hang supervisor (exit 124, REAL_FAILURE), and a full-mode pin. Fork (b): coverage.reporter stays text plus text-summary. Residual #4244 and #3512 stay out. Landed by PR 4249 (squash 6b55e61c).
narratives.UserStory: As a release operator, I want one full suite at Step 5 with a real 20-minute hang supervisor and a full-mode pin, so that a production cut does not run the suite twice or hang unbounded on the cached path.
narratives.ImplementationPlan: Edit the release skill pack so Phase 1 has no ordered-list task check. Add a check module supervisor with timeoutMs only on runReleaseCheck. Tee with exclusive create, prune that spares live tees, named-cause strings, win32 taskkill /T. Pin DEFT_CHECK_MODE=full and delete AC-only and hygiene-advisory. Verify with targeted vitest tests in packages/core/src/check and release plus task check. CHANGELOG #4230.

narrative.Acceptance: Given a fresh production cut at a clean HEAD, when Phase 1 plus task release run, then the vitest suite runs exactly once and Phase 1 has no ordered-list task check.
Given runReleaseCheck on the cached path, when the suite hangs past timeoutMs, then the supervisor kills the tree, exits 124, and classifyStep5Failure keeps REAL_FAILURE without pass_with_debt.

x-directive/evidence.pointer: packages/core/src/check/suite-gate-supervisor.test.ts#kills a hung child at timeoutMs and reports 124

narrative.Acceptance: Given a lane skip that prints SKIP_NOTICE and exits 0, when Step 5 records suite-ran, then it does not treat status run alone as executed.

x-directive/evidence.pointer: packages/core/src/check/suite-gate-supervisor.test.ts#does not treat status run plus SKIP_NOTICE as executed

narrative.Acceptance: Given releaseCheckEnv, when Step 5 starts, then DEFT_CHECK_MODE is full and DEFT_CHECK_AC_ONLY and DEFT_HYGIENE_ADVISORY are deleted.
